proof_body:
by
  intro n
  let rels : Set (FreeGroup Unit) := {FreeGroup.of () ^ n}
  let f : Unit → Multiplicative (ZMod n) := fun _ => Multiplicative.ofAdd 1
  have hr : ∀ r ∈ rels, FreeGroup.lift f r = 1 := by
    rintro r rfl
    rw [map_pow, FreeGroup.lift_apply_of, ← ofAdd_nsmul]
    simp
  let g : PresentedGroup rels := PresentedGroup.of ()
  have hg : g ^ n = 1 := by
    have h := PresentedGroup.one_of_mem (rels := rels) (x := FreeGroup.of () ^ n) rfl
    rw [map_pow] at h
    exact h
  have hz : ∀ x : PresentedGroup rels, ∃ k : ℤ, x = g ^ k := by
    intro x
    have hc : Subgroup.closure ({g} : Set (PresentedGroup rels)) = ⊤ := by
      have := PresentedGroup.closure_range_of rels
      rwa [show Set.range (PresentedGroup.of (rels := rels)) = {g} from by
        ext y
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨⟨⟩, rfl⟩; rfl
        · rintro rfl; exact ⟨(), rfl⟩] at this
    have hx : x ∈ Subgroup.closure ({g} : Set (PresentedGroup rels)) := by rw [hc]; trivial
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Subgroup.mem_closure_singleton.1 hx
    exact ⟨k, hk.symm⟩
  have hval : ∀ k : ℤ, PresentedGroup.toGroup hr (g ^ k) = Multiplicative.ofAdd ((k : ZMod n)) := by
    intro k
    rw [map_zpow, PresentedGroup.toGroup.of, ← ofAdd_zsmul]
    simp
  refine ⟨MulEquiv.ofBijective (PresentedGroup.toGroup hr) ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [injective_iff_map_eq_one]
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hz x
    rw [hval] at hx
    have h0 : (k : ZMod n) = 0 := Multiplicative.ofAdd.injective hx
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd k n).1 h0
    rw [zpow_mul, zpow_natCast, hg, one_zpow]
  · intro z
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ZMod.intCast_surjective (Multiplicative.toAdd z)
    exact ⟨g ^ k, by rw [hval, hk]; rfl⟩
target_source: ∀ (n : ℕ), Nonempty (PresentedGroup ({FreeGroup.of () ^ n} : Set (FreeGroup Unit)) ≃* Multiplicative (ZMod n))
